subject: Renewal: Add-On GPU Pool + Performance SLA — Exec pricing exception?
messages:
From: Meera Shah <meera@orchardanalytics.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: ops@orchardanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal add-on: +48 GPUs and throughput SLO — pricing ask

Hi Aditya,

Quick summary: we’re approaching renewal for our core subscription (end of Q2) and want to expand our Dedicated pool by ~48 A100-equivalent GPUs (we’ll manage instance sizing on our side). The expansion must include a 99th-percentile throughput SLO across the reserved pool — our app needs stable tail latency during batch scoring windows.

We’ve attached a short usage extract (see current consumption and peak patterns). Key asks:
- Add 48 GPUs to reserved pool starting July 1, 2027
- 24-month term for the larger commit
- 99th pct throughput SLO and a mechanism for credits if SLO is missed
- We’re asking for a one-time expansion concession to offset migration costs and burst capacity during rollout (looking for a commercial signal in the first-year pricing).

Happy to hop on a 30-min call next week to walk through traffic and risk.

Thanks,
Meera Shah
Head of Platform Engineering
Orchard Analytics
(meera@orchardanalytics.com)

Attachment: current_usage_extract.csv
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Meera Shah <meera@orchardanalytics.com>
Cc: ops@orchardanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal add-on: +48 GPUs and throughput SLO — pricing ask

Hi Meera — thanks for the clear ask and the usage extract.

We can support the reserved expansion and build a 99th-pct throughput SLO tied to the added pool. High-level proposal from our side:
- 24-month renewal with new reserved pool: +48 GPUs (reserved, not burst)
- Throughput SLO: 99th pct tail configured for the reserved pool; automated runtime fallbacks to handle rolling upgrades
- Commercial concession: proposing a one-time expansion credit equal to 12% of the first-year committed spend on the added capacity, applied as monthly bill credits over the first 3 months.

I need Exec approval for the concession level. If you’re comfortable with that framing I’ll open the internal approval thread and return with a formal SOW addendum and DocuSign link.

Proposed next step: 30-min call Tuesday or Wednesday — share availability and I’ll schedule.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0197

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal add-on: +48 GPUs and throughput SLO — executive credit ask

Marissa / Laura — forwarding the Orchard request. They want to add 48 GPUs on renewal (24 months) and are explicitly asking for an expansion concession to cover migration/burst costs.

Context and numbers:
- Customer: Orchard Analytics (HUBSPOT-2873) — SaaS analytics, heavy batch scoring overnight, predictable peaks.
- Expected ARR delta (new reserved capacity): ~$800k/year incremental committed spend for the 48 GPUs at current list pricing.
- Proposed concession (I suggested): one-time credit = 12% of first-year committed spend on added capacity (~$96k), applied as bill credits across months 1–3.
- Customer asks for SLO-backed throughput guarantee with credits on misses. Legal will handle SLO wording; commercial needs to sign off on $$ concession and whether to make it conditional on a 24-month term.

Specific ask to you both: please approve up to $120k (ceiling) of one-time expansion credit, or indicate an alternate cap and any required conditions (e.g., 24-month term, termination penalties, staged ramp milestones). If approved, I’ll share SOW_Addendum_v2.pdf and a DocuSign bundle and work with Legal/Finance on the SLO credit language.

Attachments forwarded: SOW_Addendum_v2.pdf (draft), usage_dashboard_Q1.png (peaks and tail-latency plots).

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal add-on: +48 GPUs and throughput SLO — executive credit ask

Thanks for the clear summary, Aditya. I’ve reviewed the ask and Orchard’s profile. I approve a commercial concession with conditions:

- Approved concession: one-time credit equal to 11.25% of first-year committed spend on the added capacity (approved amount ~ $90k).
- Conditions:
  - Orchard signs a 24-month term for the combined agreement (existing + added capacity).
  - Early termination clause: if they terminate before 12 months, we recoup unused credit pro rata.
  - SLO credits: Legal and Product to finalize SLO language; any monetary SLO remediation will be capped at the credit value and only trigger after three verified breaches within a 90-day rolling window.

Marissa — can you run margin impact and confirm final numbers with Finance? Dev — please prepare the SLO draft based on existing template and flag any runtime constraints for 99th-pct guarantees.

Aditya — communicate the approved structure to Meera and attach the SOW addendum + DocuSign when updated. If Orchard pushes back on the percentage, offer staged ramp: 6% up-front credit plus 6% on successful completion of the first-quarter rollout (tied to the usage milestones in the dashboard).

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
